name: @role-orchestrator/memory
description: M3-02 shared memory: typed memory entries (temporary/fact/discovery/decision/project_rule) with the per-type write-permission matrix of docs/MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT.md, the proposed -> verified -> active lifecycle with dispute/expire guards, user-only project_rule promotion through an explicit audited entry point, and (memoryId, expectedVersion) compare-and-swap on every state change — version mismatch raises a typed CAS conflict carrying the current version and content digest, never a silent overwrite. Migration 008 (memories + memory_revisions + memory_events) composes as MEMORY_MIGRATIONS = CONTEXT_MIGRATIONS + 008. A16: memory content is pure data; directive text can never produce permission side effects.
